source: Meetup city search, rounds 14-19 (120 cities: California secondary cities, Texas/Southeast secondary cities, the Mountain West and Alaska/Hawaii, and the major-metro suburb rings)
note: 11 listings from six rounds. Rounds 17 and 18 — forty cities in the New York, Chicago and mid-Atlantic suburb rings — produced nothing at all: every mahjong group they returned was already known. Round 19 re-found round 16's Portland venues because the two ran concurrently, and added Las Vegas.

listings.name: Portland Western Mahjongg — Drop-in at Capes and Crepes
listings.venueName: Capes and Crepes Board Game Cafe
listings.cost: $10 drop-in including a drink; $20 to learn
listings.description: Weekly Monday evening drop-in American Mah Jongg at Capes and Crepes board game cafe on SE Division. $10 to play, which includes a beverage, or $20 to be taught. Several sets are provided; bring your own if you have one. All levels welcome and there are plenty of newer players.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Beaverton and Anchorage-adjacent western sweeps. 4 upcoming sessions, Mondays 17:30-20:00, with Meetup recording "Every week on Monday". Both prices, the sets and the welcome to beginners are quoted from the event description. Style is stated in the title.
